                    ### Question

Which of the following is the most likely underlying cause of this patient's symptoms?

ope. Atherosclerotic plaque thrombus with complete coronary artery occlusion

The absence of ECG abnormalities and normal troponin concentration make complete coronary artery occlusion less likely.
